# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest commit on `main` receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/gaborbernat/ropi_jegyzet_latex/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for them.

## Disclosure

The target is an acknowledgment within 5 working days. The fix happens in private, and the advisory is published with
it, crediting the reporter unless they ask otherwise. Keep the vulnerability private until then, or for 90 days after
the report, whichever comes first.
